detail: Full summary: the cap drops scopes in sort order, so an entity touched from more than 12 scopes will silently lose the alphabetically-later ones. Stable and convergent by design, but it means a very hot file's scope set is a subset, not the truth. If that matters, the alternative is raising the cap or moving scope off file entities entirely (Option B).
